title: Panel data pipeline: query result → transform → field overrides → panel
answers: How does query data flow into panel rendering?
body:
Central pipeline caller: public/app/features/query/state/PanelQueryRunner.ts pipes datasource query results through transformDataFrame() (packages/grafana-data/src/transformations/transformDataFrame.ts:transformDataFrame, ~line 125) then applyFieldOverrides() (packages/grafana-data/src/field/fieldOverrides.ts:applyFieldOverrides, line 99) before producing PanelData for panel components.
applyFieldOverrides is also called directly by ~24 other consumers outside the main pipeline when they need config-applied series (e.g. public/app/features/explore/Table/TableContainer.tsx, public/app/features/explore/Graph/ExploreGraph.tsx, public/app/features/inspector/InspectDataTab.tsx, public/app/plugins/panel/live/LivePanel.tsx, public/app/plugins/panel/logstable/hooks/useExtractFields.ts).
transformDataFrame resolves DataTransformerInfo via standardTransformersRegistry (packages/grafana-data/src/transformations/standardTransformersRegistry.ts) and caches in-flight resolution promises per transformer id in a module-level Map so concurrent callers share one resolution (failures evict the entry so the next caller retries).
